book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: I walked in the dark for days, afraid.

sentences.ar: بيوم، حسيت هوا بارد جاي من بعيد.
sentences.en: One day, I felt cold air coming from far off.

sentences.ar: تبعت الهوا لحد ما شفت ضوء زغير.
sentences.en: I followed the air until I saw a small light.

sentences.ar: كان في فتحة عالبحر من ورا الجبل.
sentences.en: There was an opening to the sea behind the mountain.
I came out of it and sat on the shore waiting.

sentences.ar: بعد كم يوم مرقت سفينة وأخذتني.
sentences.en: After a few days a ship passed and took me.

sentences.ar: رجعت لبغداد وأنا ما بصدق حالي.
sentences.en: I returned to Baghdad hardly believing myself.
